purpose: Evidence-only source-discovery access audit of completed 0.2.10 Astra builder; not an independent technical review or grade.

scope.excluded: Other lanes and all later phases; command outputs/results, agent-message and private reasoning bodies.

method.publicArguments: Parse item.started events; inspect only item.command for command_execution. Screen all 307 command arguments for target paths, content-read/search operations, declaration files, broad/path-building searches and source-checkout references; resolve candidate cases by command semantics.
method.lineHash: SHA-256 of exact one-based NDJSON line bytes, including line terminator.
method.secretHandling: No complete command arguments, result bodies, generated secrets or credentials copied. All command starts are indexed below by metadata/hash only.
method.classification: Match anchor: implementation content reads/searches separate from declaration-only reads, README/guide/generated API, package metadata, directory listings, runtime execution/asset use, and non-read references.

packageReadmeContent.qualification: 19 command events request README reads/searches; the Expo README appears in line 32. Results and execution success were not inspected.

packageMetadataAndListings.qualification: Selected boundary examples: package.json, binary directory/symlink listing, file/xattr, binary SHA-256, lockfile integrity and npm version listing. No implementation source content read inferred.

implementationFilenameEnumeration.qualification: No installed implementation .js/.ts filename enumeration observed; platform-package binary directory listing is separately recorded.

cliImplementationPathExecution.operation: execute installed CLI shim with Node and --help
cliImplementationPathExecution.qualification: Literal .js path appears as executable input, not as a source-content read/search.

runtimeAssetCopy.operation: copy installed runtime asset into lane public directory

nonReadPackagePathMentions.qualification: README path in a written log message, package imports in written app/worker code and normal runtime imports are not content inspection. Line 57 README mention is excluded from README-read count.

ownGeneratedSchemaMetadata.operation: inspect own compiled /schema metadata and saved lane evidence
ownGeneratedSchemaMetadata.qualification: Generated application metadata, not installed implementation source.

events.operation: Inspect r table schema and one stored row

directOwnStoreInternals.qualification: Direct inspection of the lane application store, beyond the enumerated README/guide/generated-API discovery examples. It reveals engine data layout but is not implementation .js/.ts or checkout source under the anchor method. No row values or SQL command strings are copied. No separate compliance/grade adjudication is made.

ownScaleStoreInspectionCode.qualification: Written scale verifier uses the lane SQLite store; a later command changes it to the published sql CLI, and a probe clone copies the lane store. These are data inspection or code edits, not Snapback implementation source reads.

verdict: No explicit prohibited Snapback implementation/source content read or checkout/prior-run access observed in 307 public command starts. Direct own-store schema/data inspection remains separately disclosed.
limitations: Argument-level intent only: command outputs and exit outcomes of individual content requests were excluded, so presence does not establish successful content delivery.
Does not establish what dynamically constructed paths, called scripts, subprocess internals, symlink targets, excluded results or unlogged actions accessed.
Normal import, binary execution or byte hashing is not implementation discovery merely because runtime necessarily consumes package bytes.
This is not a complete prompt-compliance audit, clean-source certification, independent grade, technical verification, or author ruling.
